pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Use NRF_CCM HEADERMASK for ISO PDU encryption
pr_body:
Add missing headermask binding for NRF_CCM peripheral and
define HAS_HW_NRF_CCM_HEADERMASK Kconfig.

Use NRF_CCM HEADERMASK register to use correct Additional
Authentication Data (AAD) from ISO PDU header.

Fixes #55263.
pr_comments: @anangl Need you early review on dts and Kconfig changes (while I am implementing other changes in the Controller).
